title: SM64DS Co-op preview.4: online-start crash repair

tests: Controlled foreign-memory reservation: preview.3 overwrites constructor marker; preview.4 preserves it and takes safe fallback, 120 frames, exit 0
Seven Windows clients through animated menu and online game handoff: 240 frames each, zero buffered input, no faults
Portable front-end CI: all nine jobs passed, including actual Windows DS memory backend and constructor compilation

notes:
Fixes a verified startup memory-corruption bug: when Windows already owns part of the DS address range, constructor callbacks now use the safe host table instead of writing into another allocation. The controlled regression reproduces the unsafe write in preview.3 and proves the exact preview.4 executable preserves foreign memory. Seven local Windows clients passed the complete animated-menu-to-online transition; this is not seven-PC internet certification.

All players should update to preview.4, quit the old game, replace only the executable in their existing extracted game folder, and start a fresh room. Keep ROM assets, saves, settings and mods. The host should keep the existing WGS server and Playit tunnel running; no server update is required for this hotfix.

Retains readable fonts, three bindings per action, chat/moderation, character palettes, fullscreen and optional Speed & Coordinates HUD. The separate optional menu texture pack and native Linux/SteamOS/macOS games are still under development. Intermittent peer-departure pacing pauses remain under investigation; this release does not claim to fix every cause of lag or crashes.
